description: Ready-made samples in the current style: whole films and shot runs (on shelves like "Whole films", "Film openings", "Hooks"), shot recipes (groups like "Big scenes", "Instagram hook"), and samples the person saved. action list (read-only; shelf or search narrows it), open (plays one in the preview without adding it; returns its shots and the pictures it needs), close, add (puts its shots in: how add = after the shot, shot = in place of the shot, scene = over the whole scene; returns new shot ids and picture spots to fill), needs (empty picture spots; fill them with fill_spot), save (saves a scene's shots as the person's own sample). Adding is one undo step. For single ids (a camera, an action) use library; for whole saved projects use templates.

group.description: For needs: the group returned by add.

how.description: For add: add = after the shot, shot = in place of the shot, scene = over the whole scene.

id.description: A sample id (or exact name) from list.

scene.description: Scene index from 0 (with shot). Used when shot_id isn't given.

search.description: For list: words to look for.

shot.description: Shot index from 0 inside that scene (with scene; alone: in the scene on screen). A shot id works here too.

shot_id.description: The shot's id from get_project. Or give scene and shot instead. Left out: the shot on screen.

name: samples
